lines.text: AI knows the internet, but not your company.
Ask an AI about your company: can I expense a home office chair?
AI learned from public text, like websites and books.
Your company's docs are private, so it never saw them.
The fix is rag: retrieval-augmented generation.
Look up the right part of the docs first, then answer.
With rag, the app searches your company's docs and grabs only the part it needs.
Then Claude answers from it: yes, up to 300 dollars a year.
That's rag: look it up, then answer.
Follow for part two: how the lookup works.
